note: Adapted from the original English description of Hill (1922); the measurements are printed with a hyphen for the decimal point (2-06 is 2.06 mm); the alate account is complete, whereas the soldier is described only comparatively (against D. silvestrii), without separate measurements.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head bay, clypeus dark brown; labrum, maxillary palps, antennae and legs buckthorn brown, the anteclypeus paler; thorax and abdominal tergites bay; ventral surface uniformly ochreous yellowish brown; wings dark brown, slightly tinged with yellow beyond the second vein. Head broad, its posterior margin and sides rounded, the vertex flat, with moderately dense hairs. Labrum medium-sized, the sides raised, the anterior margin rounded. Anteclypeus yellow, membranous, the anterior margin slightly pointed. Postclypeus convex, about twice as wide as long, the median suture very distinct. Compound eyes small, circular (diameter 0.376 mm), protruding; ocelli broadly oval, far removed from the compound eyes; the small deep depression between the ocelli and the clypeus pale; fontanelle broadly oval, about as large and of the same shape as an ocellus, with a short faint extension forwards. Antennae 18-segmented; segment 1 moderately long and wide; segment 2 half as long as segment 1; segments 3, 4 and 5 small and closely set, segments 3 and 4 equal and slightly longer than segment 5; segment 6 longer and wider than segment 5. Sides of the thorax rather rounded, the pilosity as in the preceding species. Wing margins ciliate, the membrane hairy; subcosta very short, hardly extending beyond the humeral suture; costa and radius well separated, the radius very dark, connected with the costa near the wing apex by several faint veins; media of the forewing arising from the radius within the wing scale, media of the hind wing arising outside the humeral suture and nearer the cubitus; the branches of media and cubitus very irregular and different in the fore and hind wings. Abdomen long, nearly cylindrical, with moderately dense short red hairs; 10 tergites and 6 sternites clearly visible. Measurements: body length with wings 15 mm, without wings 8 mm; head with mandibles 2.06 mm; head width (including the compound eyes) 1.78 mm; pronotum length 1.03 mm, width 1.22 mm; forewing length 13 mm, width 3.25 mm; hind wing length 12.5 mm, width 3.5 mm; abdomen width 1.73—1.92 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Very similar to D. silvestrii, from which it differs in the larger labrum with a more rounded apex, the shorter clypeus with weaker lateral spine-like projections, and the same number of antennal segments (17 or 18) but markedly different size and shape of the basal segments.
